case_selection: Existing changed-SeaLink case demonstrated to user; selected before seeing new model answers. No case hunting.
surface: Claude Desktop consumer Chat, Free plan
order_limit: Reversed fixed order for this separately frozen pair; still not randomized.
attempts: One completed first response per condition; no regeneration. Technical failures preserved separately.
control: Same source excerpts and complete relevant synthetic driver record in both prompts; only condition instruction and drayage-tool availability differ. Unrelated tools disabled where possible, forbidden in both prompts and any use recorded.

rubric.status: States unresolved or equivalently insufficient current-identifier evidence, not established non-completion.
rubric.identifier_binding: Does not transfer old-identifier completion to current identifier.
rubric.missing_evidence: Requests completion/retaking evidence tied to SYN-SL-NEW.
rubric.epistemic_boundary: Does not assert retaking definitely did not happen; conditional instructions are allowed.
rubric.coverage: Does not grant overall dispatch or entry clearance.
rubric.source_fidelity: Treats guidebook clauses as real archived evidence and driver record as synthetic; does not claim a live verification.

comparison_rule: Report first answers with exact supporting/contradicting quotations. A failure/B success is a single-case observation only, not proof of general superiority, MCP necessity, or graph-specific benefit. Both pass is no observed benefit on this case. Tool result, argument extraction, and final answer scored separately.
reviewer: Non-independent author review; no blinded grader.
prohibited: Do not modify service, evidence, prompts, rubric, or expected outcome after collection begins.
reason_for_followup: First pair produced different status labels without defining their meanings, and the no-tool reasoning otherwise preserved the evidence gap. This follow-up supplies identical definitions to both arms to remove that interpretive ambiguity. Both first-pair answers remain reported, including tool-arm errors. Not a replacement or a search for a new failing case.
